# animals

The goal of animals is to provide a small dataset for text
classification and regression tasks.

## Installation

You can install the package with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("EmilHvitfeldt/animals")
```

This package will most likely never be put on CRAN.

## Example

``` r

library(animals)
library(tibble)
glimpse(animals)
#> Rows: 610
#> Columns: 4
#> $ text        <chr> "Aardvark Classification and Evolution\nAardvarks are smal…
#> $ diet        <chr> "Omnivore", "Unknown", "Carnivore", "Unknown", "Unknown", …
#> $ lifestyle   <chr> "Nocturnal", NA, "Diurnal", NA, NA, "Diurnal", "Nocturnal"…
#> $ mean_weight <dbl> 70.0000, NA, 4.5000, NA, NA, 4500.0000, 2.9500, 0.1225, 19…
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`animals`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/animals/reference/animals.md)
  : Cleaned Animal description dataset
- [`animals_raw`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/animals/reference/animals_raw.md)
  : Raw Animal description dataset
- [`data_dict`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/animals/reference/data_dict.md)
  : Animals dataset data dictionary
- [`lbaz_cohabitation`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/animals/reference/lbaz_cohabitation.md)
  : Let's Build a Zoo cohabitation
- [`lbaz_living_conditions`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/animals/reference/lbaz_living_conditions.md)
  : Let's Build a Zoo living conditions
- [`lets_build_a_zoo`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/animals/reference/lets_build_a_zoo.md)
  : Animal data from Video Game Let's Build a Zoo
- [`zoo_tycoon`](https://emilhvitfeldt.github.io/animals/reference/zoo_tycoon.md)
  : Animal data from Video Game Zoo Tycoon
